_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. a model sheet in razor-sharp brush and ink with one spot tone of screen blue, labeled: THE HOST (a woman of forty with a dark bob and a stillness, drawn three ways in three strokes each: seated at a table with a cassette deck, holding a phone handset and listening, and pressing play; brass rails behind her; the set drawn as a rounded television screen). Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
